# Astronomy Engine

Unmodified `source/c/astronomy.c` and `astronomy.h` from Don Cross,
https://github.com/cosinekitty/astronomy at revision
`865d3da7d8112bbc7911238052c6af4aaf877181`, retrieved 2026-10-11.

MIT license: `../notices/astronomy-engine-LICENSE.txt`, also retained in both source
files and included in the macOS bundle. Statically linked into Observation only.
No network ephemeris requests or runtime dependencies are required.
